audience: e-mail marketers who manage contact lists and campaigns in SmartEmailing

useCases.title: Count the contacts in each list
useCases.text: List the contact lists with their settings. Then list the contacts of one list to count them.

useCases.title: Review the results of recent e-mails
useCases.text: List the e-mail campaigns and newsletters. Then read the delivery, open and click totals for a period.

useCases.title: Look up a contact and its custom fields
useCases.text: Get a contact by its e-mail address, with its custom field values. List the custom fields of the account to see which ones exist.

useCases.title: Create a new contact list
useCases.text: Create a contact list with a name. The call sends no e-mail, and you add the contacts in SmartEmailing.

useCases.title: Check the automations and sign-up forms
useCases.text: List the marketing automations and the sign-up web forms of the account.
